title: CSCI 344 — Programming Language Concepts
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and distinguish between syntax and semantics in high-level programming languages.
Compare and contrast at least two programming languages to identify general principles of language design and implementation.
Apply a structured problem-solving method to analyze a programming language feature using the course's core concepts.
